name: Roadtrip: in Space!
source:
Lucy just accepted a 3-month contract position. All she has to do is keep a spaceship, The Slipstream, from falling apart... During a 3-month journey into deep space.

What could possibly go wrong?

[From [url=https://fisheranimal.itch.io/roadtrip-in-space]Itch.io[/url]]
